mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_product ( product_name, product_image, product_seriesid, product_levelid, product_badge, product_detail, available, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{productSeriesId}, #{productLevelId}, #{productBadge}, #{productDetail}, #{available}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE market_product SET product_image = #{productImage}, product_name = #{productName}, product_seriesid = #{productSeriesId}, product_levelid = #{productLevelId}, product_badge = #{productBadge}, product_detail = #{productDetail}, available = #{available}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id as productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_image AS productImage, p.product_seriesid AS productSeriesId, ps.series_name AS productSeriesName, p.product_levelid AS productLevelId, pl.level_name AS productLevelName, p.product_badge as productBadge, p.product_detail as productDetail, p.available as available, p.created_by AS createdBy, p.created_time AS createdTime, p.updated_by AS updatedBy, p.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM market_product p LEFT JOIN market_series ps ON p.product_seriesid = ps.series_id LEFT JOIN product_level pl ON p.product_levelid = pl.level_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
